ambient.intent: Non-combat presence — no attacks, so nothing to hunt with.

chase.intent: Close and pursue. Hostility is faction-only: anything not of this body's faction, player and pedestrians included.

guard.intent: Hold a post on a short leash, then engage whatever other-faction body walked into it.

skirmish.intent: Standoff / ranged pressure. Attack pool is the full caster/artillery set; AI selection among them is deferred.

wander_hunt.intent: Roam until something of another faction is in aggro range, then chase it.
